scope: Cost diagnostic of the adopted whole FFN; not an optimization family, candidate adoption or official submission
method_change_from_initial_proposal: Existing compiled E104 image exposes native trace markers. Used intact whole-kernel execution rather than adding isolated-stage output boundaries.

verified_engine_correspondence.method: Complete ordered kind correspondence and monotone runtime issue/start order; runtime does not supply source annotations

front_end_main_gap.meaning: No mapped Main operation from the end of pre-RMS to activation amax, while the large gate weight transfer overlaps the input replication interval.

interpretation.leading_hypothesis: Bulk gate weight supply delays latency-sensitive activation replication/preparation on the shared transfer path; full FP8 materialization is another substantial Main interval.
not_established: Pure transfer service time from a DMA span
Additive fractions of uninstrumented FFN runtime
A guaranteed speedup from eliminating any observed gap

next_design_requirements: Co-design normalized activation producer, term preparation/distribution and bulk weight ownership/prefetch granularity; verify lowered dependency and resource order, not source statement order.
For streaming or tiled decode, address the concrete prior C07 correctness failure rather than retrying the same composition.
Compare full paths including all conversions, small transfers, padding and scale/partials against contemporary E104 controls.
why_stop: Two successful immutable allocations provide stable per-operation evidence and a reproducible front-end gap. Additional boundary probes or sweeps are not needed to select the next architectural question.
